stem: An engineering team creates assistive software extensions and hardware adaptations so that people can complete everyday tasks they would otherwise be unable to do. Which disability model guides their approach?

options.rationale: The charity model depends on sympathy and humanitarian assistance rather than technological problem-solving.
The functional solutions model seeks to overcome real-world limitations through targeted engineering, design, and innovation.
The economic model emphasizes labor output and public expenditures rather than creating tools to perform tasks.
The biopsychosocial model integrates biological, psychological, and social factors rather than centering on engineering solutions.

explanation: The functional solutions model approaches disability as a series of specific practical limitations that can be addressed through technological, methodological, and design innovation. It is the practical lens through which many accessibility specialists work.

references.title: IAAP CPACC, Body of Knowledge v4.0
